# v1.14.1

## Gallery upload, user-delete fix, board focus fix

### Files: upload from the gallery (mobile)
The project Datoteke screen gains a third action — **Galerija** (between
Datoteka and Slikaj). It opens the phone's photo gallery, and the chosen photo
goes through the same pipeline as a camera shot: downscale above 1600 px, name
dialog (pre-filled with the photo's own file name when meaningful, otherwise
"Slika dd.mm.yyyy."), upload as `image/jpeg`. Cancel at any step uploads
nothing.

### User management: delete no longer fails with "Internal Server Error" (backend)
Deleting a user who ever created a project, board, task or file hit foreign-key
violations (`projects.owner_id`, `boards.owner_id`, `tasks.created_by_id` /
`assignee_id`, `files.uploaded_by_id` have no `ON DELETE CASCADE`). `DELETE
/api/users/{id}` now re-links owned rows to the acting admin (shared workspace —
nothing is per-user), clears task assignments, then deletes the account.
Notifications and push rows keep cascading at the DB level. Self-delete and
other-admin deletions stay rejected as before.

### Mobile board: no more jumping to the first column (mobile)
Adding a task or a Nabava item rebuilt the horizontal board list, which reset
the scroll to column 1 — after every add the user had to scroll back to the
column they were working in. The horizontal position is now remembered before
every reload and restored after the new layout pass (clamped, so boards that
shrank remotely don't break). Reloads with data on screen no longer flash a
full-screen spinner either.

**Bonus fix found while diagnosing:** the same root cause made **editing** a
task on mobile silently move it to the first column — the edit dialog
initialized the column picker from `columns.first` (the API didn't return the
task's column) and the PATCH applied `column_id` unconditionally. The API now
returns `column_id` per task (additive), the dialog pre-selects the task's real
column and only sends `column_id` when the user actually changes it, and the
backend treats `column_id`/`position` as optional on PATCH (omitted = keep
current; POST unchanged).

## Verified
- Backend: `py_compile`, **10/10 pytest** (user-deletion re-link + guards,
  optional column_id PATCH contract, webpush suite, file deletion, counts)
- Flutter checks (analyze + tests incl. new gallery-upload and scroll-retention
  suites) run in CI on the tag — SDK unavailable in this environment
- Compose configs valid
